title: 1999 SkyBox Dominion Nick Williams & Scott Covington #222 RC Bengals Rookie
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 1999 SkyBox Dominion sports trading card featuring Nick Williams and Scott Covington of the Cincinnati Bengals. It is a rookie card numbered 222 from the set. The card does not have an autograph and is manufactured by SkyBox. It is part of the NFL league and is a collectible item for football fans.
